## Before Submitting
- [ ] I checked the latest code on the main branch and this feature is not already implemented there.
- [ ] I searched the existing issues and this is not a duplicate.

## Problem Statement
A clear and concise description of the problem or limitation you are encountering. (For example, "I need to configure per-route rate limits because...")

## Proposed Solution
A clear description of what you want to happen and how you propose implementing it in Aegora. Include API contracts, configuration schemas, or middleware ordering considerations where applicable.

## Alternatives Considered
Describe any alternative solutions, designs, or workarounds you have considered and why they were discarded.

## Implementation Willingness
- [ ] I am willing to implement this feature and submit a pull request.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, diagrams, or references to relevant RFCs or distributed systems literature here.
